transcript.text: gas hob keeps clickin on its own since i cleand it, stops then starts agen. drivin me mad. pls help

First switch it off at the wall or cooker switch and let it cool completely. From what you have described, the most likely cause is a burner cap that was wet, dirty or not seated. The usual cause is a burner cap that isn't sitting square, or one that's wet or greasy after cleaning. Lift off the cap and crown, dry and clean them (and gently wipe the white igniter tip), then re-seat them so they sit flat. Was a cap out of place, wet or dirty (and is it sorted), or were they all seated, dry and clean?
yeah i sloshed loads of water about and took the caps off. one cap looked a bit wonky so i put it back proper. wiped a bit of grease off the igniter too. no gas smell tho
Could you tell me a bit more about what it is doing, and when it happens?
its a rapid ticking from one or maybe more burners even when the knobs are off. comes and goes, started this morning after i cleaned it. burners still light fine when i use them
From what you have checked, this needs an appliance engineer to look at it: the next steps are beyond the checks that are safe to do yourself.
